people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

people.name: Martha
people.line: Sister of Mary and Lazarus, hosted Jesus.

translations.web: Therefore Martha said to Jesus, “Lord, if you would have been here, my brother wouldn’t have died.
translations.bsb: Martha said to Jesus, “Lord, if You had been here, my brother would not have died.
translations.kjv: Then said Martha unto Jesus, Lord, if thou hadst been here, my brother had not died.
translations.asv: Martha therefore said unto Jesus, Lord, if thou hadst been here, my brother had not died.
